# lib/reorder-motion

## Variables

### reorderKeyAttribute

```ts
const reorderKeyAttribute: "data-reorder-key" = "data-reorder-key";
```

The attribute that names one keyed child of a list with list motion.

## Functions

### useListMotion()

```ts
function useListMotion(container, order): void;
```

Motion for a keyed list. Rows that arrive fade in over the theme's travel
(staggered by `--stipe-motion-stagger`) once the list has unrolled to make room.
A row that leaves fades where it stood first; then the rest close ranks, gliding
to their places (FLIP on the Web Animations API) as the list eases to its new
height. Everything reads the theme's motion tokens; reduced motion keeps only
short fades and nothing travels. Children opt in with `data-reorder-key`, and
the first render is still.

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                   |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `container` | `RefObject`\<`HTMLElement` \| `null`\> |
| `order`     | readonly `string`[]                    |

#### Returns
